title: Restructure the small controls
summary: Footer links become a grid of 48px board-style tiles (two columns on phones, "Obsazení: sto postav" shortened to "Obsazení" to fit), "Vzdát se a ukázat odpovědi" moves into a "⋯" menu button next to "Tipnout", the Mimo tabuli names become 44px chips with the person's face, and the wordmark and "Odhlásit se" get 44px boxes.
tradeoffs: Most thorough and gives the footer a stronger board look, but giving up is now hidden behind "⋯" (less discoverable, which may be a feature) and the footer changes noticeably.
